summary: BCB Bancorp filed an 8-K on June 18, 2026, announcing its board voted to suspend quarterly cash dividends on common and preferred stock, and to suspend its 2026 Amended and Restated Dividend Reinvestment and Stock Purchase Plan. No terms such as stake or price were provided, as this is a dividend suspension, not a capital return event. The company cited forward-looking risks including macroeconomic uncertainty, tariffs, and inflation. This routine dividend action does not constitute a special situation; it is an ordinary corporate liquidity measure with no deal mechanics, premium, or advisor involvement.
